title: Investigation of peri-implant tissue conditions and peri-implant tissue stability in implants placed with simultaneous augmentation procedure: a 3-year 25 retrospective follow-up analysis of a newly developed bone level implant system
authors: Lorenz J, Lerner H, Sader RA, Ghanaati S. Int J Implant Dent. 2017 Sep 5;3(1):41. doi: 10.1186/s40729- 017-0104-4.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss maxresorb / maxresorb inject (biphasic CaP) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “In conclusion, implants placed in combination with a GBR procedure can achieve long-term stable functionally and esthetically satisfying results for replacing missing teeth in cases of atrophy of the alveolar crest” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
